Defect Title: CWE-213 / OWASP API3:2023 - Over-fetching & Sensitive Data Exposure on Public GET /jobs
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Send unauthenticated HTTP GET to https://api.dev.hire.zobay.in/jobs
2. Inspect the JSON response body under job.company and job.recruiter
Expected Result: Public job listings must only serialize safe attributes (name, logo, website). Internal operational keys must be stripped.
Actual Observed Result: Public response contains company.digitalSignatureUrl and serializes internal database fields, exposing sensitive executive signing assets.
Root Cause Analysis: Backend Prisma query lacks a restrictive `select` clause or DTO serialization interceptor, returning the entire Company database model directly.
Suggested Technical Fix: Implement a strict JobPublicResponseDto using class-transformer with @Exclude() on sensitive properties or use explicit Prisma select query.

Defect Title: Unhandled HTTP 500 Internal Server Crash on Interview Feedback Submission
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Authenticate as Technical Interviewer (rahul.sharma@hirex.dev)
2. Send POST to /interviewer/interviews/185f2a88-8d6f-4c0b-bb19-a064877e499c/feedback with rating payload
Expected Result: Backend should validate interview lifecycle status. If interview is in ASSIGNED status, return HTTP 400 Bad Request with actionable message.
Actual Observed Result: Backend unhandled exception crashes with HTTP 500 Internal Server Error ('{"statusCode":500,"message":"Internal server error"}').
Root Cause Analysis: Service method attempts an unchecked database update or relies on an unhandled state precondition, throwing an unhandled Prisma/NestJS exception.
Suggested Technical Fix: Wrap feedback service in status pre-check: if (interview.status !== 'IN_PROGRESS' && interview.status !== 'COMPLETED') throw new BadRequestException(...).

Defect Title: Unhandled HTTP 500 Internal Server Crash on Interviewer Invite Missing 'name' Parameter
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Authenticate as Recruiter Admin
2. Send POST /recruiter/interviewers/invite with payload: {"email": "test@example.com"} (omitting 'name')
Expected Result: ValidationPipe must intercept missing mandatory field and return HTTP 400 Bad Request: 'name should not be empty'.
Actual Observed Result: Backend crashes with HTTP 500 Internal Server Error due to null constraint violation in database layer.
Root Cause Analysis: The invite interviewer DTO either lacks @IsNotEmpty() and @IsString() on 'name', or the controller lacks global ValidationPipe.
Suggested Technical Fix: Add class-validator annotations to InviteInterviewerDto: @IsNotEmpty() @IsString() name: string; and enable whitelist: true.

Defect Title: Unhandled HTTP 500 Internal Server Crash on Team Member Invite with Invalid Role Enum
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Authenticate as Recruiter Admin
2. Send POST /recruiter/team/invite with payload: {"email": "user@example.com", "role": "INVALID_SUPER_USER"}
Expected Result: Validation layer must reject invalid role with HTTP 400 Bad Request: 'role must be one of ADMIN, MEMBER'.
Actual Observed Result: Backend crashes with HTTP 500 Internal Server Error ('{"statusCode":500,"message":"Internal server error"}').
Root Cause Analysis: Prisma schema enforces an Enum for recruiter roles (e.g., RecruiterRole: ADMIN, MEMBER). Passing an invalid string causes Prisma Client to throw an unhandled query error.
Suggested Technical Fix: Decorate the DTO property with @IsEnum(RecruiterRole) to reject invalid roles at the API gateway before executing Prisma database queries.

Defect Title: Lack of Email Syntax Validation on Recruiter Team Invite Endpoint (Phantom Account Injection)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Authenticate as Recruiter Admin
2. Send POST /recruiter/team/invite with payload: {"email": "malformed_string_without_at", "role": "MEMBER"}
Expected Result: Backend must validate email format against RFC 5322 and reject malformed strings with HTTP 400 Bad Request.
Actual Observed Result: Backend accepts malformed string, returns HTTP 201 Created, persists a database recruiter record, and generates active invite token.
Root Cause Analysis: InviteTeamDto treats 'email' as a plain string without @IsEmail() decorator, bypassing email validation on the backend service.
Suggested Technical Fix: Add @IsEmail({}, { message: 'A valid email address must be provided' }) to InviteTeamDto to prevent database pollution.

Defect Title: Broken Resume Asset Storage URLs with Hardcoded localhost:3001 Origin in Cloud Environment
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Authenticate as Recruiter or Candidate
2. Query GET /recruiter/applications/app-rahul-innovatex-01 or GET /candidate/resume
3. Inspect resumeSnapshotUrl and fileUrl attributes
Expected Result: Resume asset URLs must resolve to public cloud storage CDN (https://storage.hire.zobay.in or Cloudflare R2 bucket domain).
Actual Observed Result: fileUrl and resumeSnapshotUrl contain 'http://localhost:3001/uploads/placeholder-resume.pdf', causing ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED when viewing/downloading resumes.
Root Cause Analysis: Database seeding script or resume service hardcodes development local port 3001 instead of resolving storage base URL from environment variables.
Suggested Technical Fix: Update resume entity serialization or seed migration to use process.env.STORAGE_PUBLIC_URL or R2 bucket endpoint instead of localhost.

Defect Title: Missing Non-Empty Validation on Candidate Profile Name Update (Allows Blank Candidate Dossiers)
Expected Result: Backend must enforce non-empty string validation (@IsNotEmpty(), @MinLength(1)) and reject empty strings with HTTP 400 Bad Request.
Actual Observed Result: Backend returns HTTP 200 OK and successfully updates candidate name to an empty string (''), creating blank candidate records across pipeline dossiers.
Root Cause Analysis: UpdateCandidateProfileDto annotates 'name' with @IsString() and @IsOptional(), but omits @IsNotEmpty() and @MinLength(1).
Suggested Technical Fix: Add @IsNotEmpty({ message: 'name cannot be empty' }) and @MinLength(1) to UpdateCandidateProfileDto.
